changelog:
✨ New Features
• Enable audio/video switch: Add "Always play the song version" setting
• Hide layout components: Add "Hide 'You may also like' section" setting
• Miniplayer : Add glass miniplayer, independent glass controls, spinning vinyl artwork, and dedicated miniplayer settings screen
• Third-party lyrics: Add spring scroll physics, instrumental gap indicators, retimed sync, and jump to current button
• Add Disable audio ducking patch
• Downloads: Quick download menu with qualities, file sizes and the MP3 marked (YTindir)
• Third-party lyrics: Lyrics panel detection various fixes

🌟 Mod Features
• All Morphe patches for YT Music
• Customizable preset settings
• Extra clone variant with Dynamic Island on supported devices
• In-app update check for new builds

🐛 Bug Fixes
• Crossfade: Equalizer apps detach from the outgoing track during the fade
• Crossfade: Volume normalization is lost after a crossfade
• Downloads: Some playlists cannot be downloaded in-app
• Enable audio/video switch: Toggle opens a Mix or switches to the wrong song
• Third-party lyrics: Downloads patch breaks YouTube Music lyrics
• Theme: Bottom sheets do not follow theme
• Theme: Menus and sheets (quick download, playlist tags, SoundProof...) stay grey #212121 instead of the theme color. They now use the theme color, #0F0F0F in the Original and Amoled variants
• Updates: The update dialog reminds to install the downloaded APK from the Downloads folder
